changes: Cart joins point-invoice warmup directly without a preceding redundant delivery preview.
Valid near-expiry invoice is reused for navigation; background warmup handles renewal without extending server expiry.
Checkout warms point invoices every 15 seconds only while foreground/current and idle.
Address acceptance no longer waits for quote and offers requests; binding quote invalidated only when address ID changes.
Address initialization loads pricing and offers concurrently; removed duplicate auto-application because offer loading already invokes it.
preserved: Exact basket, location, account and promotion cache scoping
Authoritative final commercial review and changed-total approval

validation.device: Release 395 installed and launched on iMohammed

limitations: This change removes client-side duplicate waits. Server route/pricing latency still exists when a fresh calculation is genuinely required.
No server deployment or shared cross-request authentication cache introduced.
